assets.description: whole tree in the void (trunk + canopy) from void_lookup_B. Canopy over the skylight: clean difference key against the sky/glazing plate. Canopy over rails, curtains and walls: hue-based leaf classification + dark branch pixels inside the leaf envelope, morphological cleanup, 2 px projection band. Trunk: fitted polygon (robust edge polynomials). HONEST NOTE: the lower canopy (below the skylight) has occasional small background bits between leaves (warm wall/ceiling patches) and a few pale lit twigs are dropped; fine at collage scale, inspect before using > 60 %.
assets.suggested_use: hero tree of collage 01; trunk_base is where the trunk leaves the bottom edge

assets.description: only the canopy region over the glazed skylight (cut by the skylight outline, anti-aliased) - the cleanest leaf edges of the set.
assets.suggested_use: luminous green-gold canopy layer over the skylight / light plane
